title: SerenAI: State-transition system inspired by text-based world AI models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although professional workflows leverage large language models widely, the interpretation for auditing unconstrained free-text generation is usually intractable if such generation demands legal, operational or financial workflow. We hereby demonstrate a text based system called SerenAI - inspired by world-models, it is a state transition system that outputs verifiable predictions rather than merely text: Provided with a description of the environment, state, and actions, the generated output contains 4 items: causal deltas that causally effect the given state, a next state that can logically follow from the given state and action, a validity reward, and a termination signal. For the released proto-model, we employ 2 steps of adaptation training, namely parameter efficient fine-tuning followed by verifier based RL over 50,000 exampled cause and effects in 12 environments spanning 10 reasoning domains. translated_title: SerenAI：受文本世界AI模型启发的状态转移系统
translated_abstract: 尽管专业工作流已广泛使用大语言模型，但当此类文本生成涉及法律、运营或金融工作流时，对无约束自由文本生成进行审计解释通常十分困难。我们在此展示一个名为 SerenAI 的基于文本的系统——它受世界模型启发，是一个输出可验证预测而非仅仅是文本的状态转移系统：给定环境、状态和动作的描述，其生成的输出包含4项内容：对给定状态产生因果影响的因果增量、可以从给定状态和动作逻辑推导出的下一状态、有效性奖励，以及终止信号。对于已发布的原型模型，我们采用了两步适应训练，即先进行参数高效微调，再进行基于验证器的强化学习，训练数据涵盖跨越10个推理领域的12个环境中的50,000个因果关系示例。与最初的内部评估相比……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SerenAI 是一个受世界模型启发的文本状态转移系统，通过参数高效微调与基于验证器的强化学习训练，输出包含因果增量、下一状态、有效性奖励和终止信号的可验证预测，从而使大语言模型的自由文本生成变得可审计。
en_tdlr: SerenAI is a world-model-inspired text-based state transition system trained via parameter-efficient fine-tuning and verifier-based RL, which outputs verifiable predictions—causal deltas, next states, validity rewards, and termination signals—to make unconstrained free-text LLM generation auditable.
